X.npy: Received complex64 vector: unit-power clean crop plus complex AWGN; stored received power is not normalized after noise.
y.npy: Zero-based local class index into mode_names.json. Different array versions need not share class IDs.
snr_db.npy: Target clean/AWGN power ratio in dB over the full 6000 Hz complex bandwidth, not equal in-band SNR.
channel_profile.npy: Index into channel_profiles.json: 0 good, 1 moderate, 2 poor, 3 flutter.
source_id.npy: Index into source_recordings.json; one source recording per local class.
split_id.npy: 0 train, 1 val, 2 test; must agree with benchmark_split_indices.npz.
crop_start_iq.npy: Zero-based sample offset at 6 kHz within the independently processed raw partition, not within the complete WAV.
raw_partition_start.npy: Inclusive raw WAV sample index at that recording's audio sampling rate.
raw_partition_stop.npy: Exclusive raw WAV sample index at that recording's audio sampling rate.
fading_seed.npy: Seed for the complete local configuration/profile/split fading realization, shared across SNRs only within that split.
impairment_seed.npy: Per-vector RNG seed controlling crop choice, CFO, phase and Gaussian noise; reproduction also requires the source and generator version.
cfo_hz.npy: Per-vector frequency offset in Hz, uniform in [-250,250].
phase_rad.npy: Per-vector initial phase in radians, uniform in [0,2*pi).
clean_power.npy: Measured faded-crop average power BEFORE unit-power normalization, not the stored noisy-vector power.
realized_snr_db.npy: Finite-vector clean/noise power ratio after normalization; need not equal the target exactly.
benchmark_split_indices.npz: Int64 train, val and test arrays partitioning all rows once. Shared across model training seeds.
paired_id.npy: Duration diagnostic only: corresponding 2048-/8192-point pair ID; separate normalization in each arm.
